items.title: Myra Menville Interview, 1958-05-07, 09
items.q: El Marocco... had George Lewis. At his best.

ctx.x: No, he was still playing, but he played any number of concerts for us. And Eddie Pearson's group, Paul Barbarine's group, George Lewis's group. That's talking about nothing with the Negroes. Shock, it was Steve Adorn on the room in front. And we dug him up. And Harry Shields, who was Larry's brother, he was running a diesel engine at night on a switch engine, LNN, and so on down the line, one after the other like that. And we just finally get together and play and jam, bring him up to the club, and finally we…
Since the... The Bible of the... Small bands, what about the use of them at private parties?
